messages:
user_jt: Hey—signed up today and completed email verification but the trial credits never showed up. account: acct_0x9f3c. I hit the API and got 403 on the first call.

lina_support: Sorry about that, and welcome! Can you confirm which country you're signing up from and whether you used a VPN or corporate IP? Also paste the email you used.

user_jt: Using mobile in Singapore. No VPN. email: jay.taylor+redwood@gmail.com

lina_support: Thanks. Giving me a sec to look up the account in the admin console.

support-bot: [AUTOMATED] New signup: acct_0x9f3c created 2026-03-12 08:22 UTC, email_verified=true, promo_eligibility=unknown

lina_support: I see a 'promo_hold' flag on the account with reason=region_check. Looks like the promo engine flagged the account for manual review because signup region doesn't match billing country.

user_jt: Huh — I didn't add a payment method yet. Is that expected?

lina_support: Sometimes our anti-fraud rules run when IP location and country inferred from email/billing mismatch or when there's no payment method. TL;DR: should be quick to resolve. Could you confirm whether you started the signup from your phone carrier IP or via a corporate Wi‑Fi?

user_jt: Home mobile carrier IP.

lina_support: Ok. I'll escalate to BillingOps to clear the promo_hold if everything else checks out. Sam, can you take a look? Account acct_0x9f3c, promo_hold=region_check, email jay.taylor+redwood@gmail.com

sam_billing: On it. Quick checks: no payment method, email verified, no previous promos. Running the manual clearance flow now.

alex_eng: FYI re: reproducibility — we had a small change last week that tightened the geo-mismatch threshold. Noting in case we see a spike.

sam_billing: I ran the audit log and see: 
```
evt=promo_evaluation id=acct_0x9f3c result=hold reason=geo_mismatch ip_country=SG email_domain_country=US
```
I'm going to override the hold and grant 300 trial credits.

sam_billing: Executed admin command:
```
admin grant_credits acct_0x9f3c amount=300 reason="manual_grant:geo_override"
```

support-bot: [AUTOMATED] Credits granted: acct_0x9f3c +300 trial_credits by sam_billing

lina_support: @user_jt you should see the credits applied now. Can you refresh the dashboard and try a simple API call?

user_jt: Refresh done — I see 300 credits, thanks! Did anything else need from me?

lina_support: No, all set. Marking as resolved. We'll follow up internally about the geo rules; alex_eng noted a config tweak. Sorry for the friction and thanks for the quick responses. :party:

user_jt: Appreciate it, thanks everyone :raised_hands:
